title: List the signed-in user's contributed records
preconditions: An approved institutional session is available.
The account has contributed at least one record, or the empty state is being verified.

steps.action: Open /my-experiences with an account that has no contributions.
steps.expected: An empty state explains that no experiences have been shared yet.

steps.action: Open the route with an account that owns records.
steps.expected: Only records authored by that account are listed, newest first.
